act7/apocalypse_fork.title: Where the end picks a mouth
act7/apocalypse_fork.body:
There is no third column pretending neutrality: the apocalypse **demands** a verb. Either you **hold** the world as one holds an open wound, or you **serve** as kindling and call your name **light** so you need not see what you become beneath.

The wind stops for an instant — not to spare you. To **hear** which of the two mouths you will open.

choices.text: Try to stitch the firmament with thought and prayer — one thread at a time
choices.preview: Mind check; success grants faith and a mark; failure tears faith and stains the skin.

choices.text: Feed the fire with what still burns inside you
choices.preview: −1 supply · +2 corruption · mark of fire witness.

act7/before_final_horizon.title: Before the last horizon
act7/before_final_horizon.body:
The horizon **reveals** the final line: not a border — a **receipt** of flight. Closing here is **incomplete**: the axis still descends into magma.

The wind **stops** again. This time it is not courtesy — it is **expectation** from those who choose sky over floor.

choices.text: Descend into the magma deeps — refuse the incomplete ending
choices.preview: The crucible still waits — the sky is not victory.

choices.text: Descend into the magma deeps — refuse the incomplete ending
choices.preview: Descend now, before closing the diary under a lying sky.

choices.text: Offer faith as coin — buy silence from the sky for an instant
choices.preview: −2 faith · incomplete ending — flight to the sky
choices.lockedHint: The sky charges faith that still exists — you need at least 1 to open this contract.
diaryTexts: I paid the sky with what vertical I had left. Body remained — excuse did not. The axis, below, stayed unclosed.

choices.text: Give what remains of human to the rumor — let the skin learn the price
diaryTexts: I did not bargain with God — I bargained with fire. The result is the same: less skin, more truth — and the floor of the axis still to visit.

choices.text: Press on without offering — bare step only
diaryTexts: I left no offering on the altar of the end — only footprints. If the world charges later, it will know where to find me: still above the true floor.

act7/cinder_tithe_fail.title: Biting ash
act7/cinder_tithe_fail.body:
The pile **ignites** without flame: heat that **steals** sweat and **patience**. When you retreat, you carry **corruption** in the throat — not possession; **residue** of having touched what was not yours.

---

choices.text: Leave the mound with burning hands and a closed mouth

onEnterDiaryTexts: The ash was alive — or I was dead enough to confuse the two. I lost time and skin in the same place.

act7/cinder_tithe_ok.title: Dry luck
act7/cinder_tithe_ok.body:
You choose the right mound as one who **smells** a lie on the wind. Beneath the ash: cold **gold**, melted into useless shapes — but **gold** all the same.

---

choices.text: Slip the find into your pocket and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: The ash gave way — a pouch of melted gold that still pretended to be coin. I did not thank it; gratitude draws eyes.

act7/epilogue_apocalypse.title: Epilogue — incomplete ashes
act7/epilogue_apocalypse.body:
The world **continues** without you; your **echo** divides among **road**, **mark**, and **silence** bought or refused.

This is **not** complete victory — it is **flight** to the sky. The floor of the axis stayed below, burning. *(You can **save** from the menu or **start over**.)*

choices.text: Close the diary — flight to the sky

onEnterDiaryTexts: The apocalypse did not end — it only grew honest: ash with a name, wind with a ledger, and me pretending the sky was the floor. The axis still descended.

act7/event_ash_sermon.title: Sermon in the ash
act7/event_ash_sermon.body:
An ashen **preacher** gestures at a **rift** where the sky should be — empty audience, gesture of **official** ending.

You laugh, or you pay so the laugh does not become **guilt** — today: **coin** and reputation with those who pretend order.

choices.text: Toss a coin into the plate and move on — charity grows tired too

onEnterDiaryTexts: A faceless preacher begged alms in the name of a god who no longer has a city. I paid so he would fall silent before I did.

act7/event_cinder_tithe.title: Ash tithe
act7/event_cinder_tithe.body:
Someone **stacked** ashes like a portable altar. On top: a human **tooth**, too clean. A sign without ink asks if you still believe in **luck** when the world is already **ash and bone**.

---
act7/event_cinder_tithe.luckCheckLabel: Guess which ash mound still hides a tooth

act7/event_last_train.title: Last train of dust
act7/event_last_train.body:
An open **car**, full of **dust** that was once people. The engineer is a **clock** stopped at the center of the dial — smiling as one who knows **delay** and **end** are the same word with different accents.

**Three coins** buy a place at the edge — not to flee: to **remember** that fleeing is also a way of **praying**.

choices.text: Climb into the car and let the wind steal what remains

onEnterDiaryTexts: I saw a train without rails — only crates and dust. I paid passage with gold that bought nothing anywhere anymore; I gained an instant of faith like a nap before the ceiling falls.

act7/event_silent_bell.title: Bell without a tongue
act7/event_silent_bell.body:
In the middle of the wasteland, a **bell** hung from nothing — **tongue** torn out, clapper **mute**. Still, the air **vibrates** as if someone had just **lied** aloud.

To ring or not to ring: the price is not written — it is **in the hand**.

choices.text: Hold the clapper with a gloved hand — pay in faith what has no price in gold
diaryTexts: I touched a bell that had no sound — only weight. Faith left my chest like coin.

choices.text: Let the metal gnaw the promise that still lies to you
diaryTexts: The bell did not toll — it chewed. I was left with the taste of old secret on the tongue.

act7/fight_hollow_intro.title: Hollow procession
act7/fight_hollow_intro.body:
Figures **aligned** too neatly to be alive: **cult** without eyes, **bone** without history. They advance like **rhythm** — and rhythm, in the end, is only another form of **siege**.

---

choices.text: Cut the line before they canonize you without consent

onEnterDiaryTexts: They came like a procession — bone masks and torn habit. They did not want blessing; they wanted body.

act7/opening_terminal_glow.title: Terminal glow
act7/opening_terminal_glow.body:
The **air** smells of burnt paper and **iron** too cold; clouds **threaten** without rain — **silence with teeth**.

The road **splits**: **stitch** the sky until it falls silent, or **let it** tear and dance in the ash. One step is already a **side**.

choices.text: Walk until the sky stops pretending color

onEnterDiaryTexts: I left the nave and the world was not continuation — it was collection. The horizon drew a red line like one closing an account.

act7/path_ember_devour.title: Living kindling
act7/path_ember_devour.body:
You open your throat and the heat **answers** without asking a name: not pulpit possession — **agreement** with what already burned in you before the end of the world was fashionable.

The fire **eats** supply and **leaves** corruption as a crest: you are not saint; you are a walking **chimney** — and the road favors those who do not pretend cold.

choices.text: Cool your chest in the ash and move on — fire is also a path

onEnterDiaryTexts: I did not stitch the sky — I fed what already burned. Heat does not forgive, but it covers cold like a dirty blanket.

act7/path_stitch_sky.title: Thread in the sky
act7/path_stitch_sky.body:
You raise your hands without credentials. The sky **is not fabric** — it is static **threat** — but the mind insists on stitching: pattern where there is none, **meaning** where there is only fear.

Each second the design **holds** is a second the world does not swallow you whole.
act7/path_stitch_sky.skillCheckLabel: Hold a pattern in the chaos before the retina gives up

act7/stitch_failure.title: Broken thread
act7/stitch_failure.body:
The diagram **tears** and the world returns pure **noise**: not clean defeat — **entry** of another language into your head, one that asks no translation, only **obedience**.

Something in you **yields** with the right sound: less **trust** in what is above, more **seduction** by what bites back.

choices.text: Spit the taste of metal and move on on your knees if you must

onEnterDiaryTexts: The pattern slipped from me. The sky laughed without sound and I was left with a mouth full of ash — faith is no guarantee; it is a wager.

act7/stitch_success.title: Stitch that holds
act7/stitch_success.body:
The horizon **shudders** and retreats half a tone: not a plaza miracle — a **truce** of the laboratory. You feel **faith** not as rule, but as **muscle** that bore the weight without breaking.

The stitch does not vanish: it stays as a **fine line** in vision, reminder that mind is also **tool** — and tools grow tired.

choices.text: Lower your hands and move on — the wasteland still demands legs

onEnterDiaryTexts: I saw the sky as diagram — for an instant, it obeyed. I paid with cold sweat, not with lie.

act7/wasteland_antechamber.title: Antechamber of ash
act7/wasteland_antechamber.body:
The road does **not** turn back — it only **branches** into lesser evils. Before the last horizon, the wasteland imposes **one** event that asks no apology: sermon, blade, or **bell** without clapper.

This is **not** the floor of the axis — it is flight to the sky. The true close still **burns** below.

choices.text: Let the wind decide the next sacrifice
choices.preview: Wasteland event — sermon, blade, or bell.

choices.text: Descend into the magma deeps — the true floor
choices.preview: Abandon the incomplete ending and return to the Crucible.

choices.text: Descend into the magma deeps — first throat
choices.preview: The axis still descends; the ash sky is not the floor.

choices.text: Return to Graywind Heights
choices.preview: Return to the ice — the axis links surface and deeps.

act7/wasteland_router.title: Wasteland that draws lots
act7/wasteland_router.body:
The wind **carries** a smell that is neither earth nor city — it is **debt** outstanding. Something moves in the ash: sometimes **voice**; other times **shape**; other times only **hunger** with footsteps.

When you stop trying to control the map, the wasteland **chooses** your next sin — small, but **etched**.
